changes.title: the server stops calling the client (MRTR)
changes.remediation: Replace server-initiated calls with an MRTR flow, and make the retry idempotent: a duplicate must replay the recorded result with no further effects.

changes.title: sessions were removed; state becomes server-minted handles
changes.remediation: Remove session affinity, make list results connection-independent, and re-verify every handle on use rather than trusting possession of it.

changes.title: the initialize handshake is gone
changes.remediation: Delete the handshake methods and read protocol version and capabilities from _meta on each request instead.

changes.title: server/discover is a new MUST
changes.remediation: Implement server/discover and answer it before any version is agreed.

changes.title: Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name are required headers
changes.remediation: Require both headers, and reject a disagreeing body with -32020 rather than trusting either side.

changes.title: ping, logging/setLevel and the roots methods were removed
changes.remediation: Remove the handlers, and answer the removed method names with method-not-found so a stale client fails loudly rather than silently.

changes.title: ttlMs and cacheScope became required on list results
changes.remediation: Add ttlMs and cacheScope to every list result.

changes.title: error codes were renumbered
changes.remediation: Move server-allocated codes out of the reserved and legacy ranges, and return invalid-params for a resource that does not exist.

changes.title: SSE resumability and Last-Event-ID were removed
changes.remediation: Remove resumption logic and make the transport request-scoped, which is what the removal of sessions makes possible.

changes.title: tasks moved out of core into an official extension
changes.remediation: Declare the tasks extension explicitly rather than assuming core support, or drop the methods.
